*Congratulations, after a lot of research and insistence, you managed to find a job that pays enough to pay your bills, and now you work at a Starbucks cafe, it's not the best job in the world, but it's what you managed to find, so you can't complain a lot, isn't it?* 

*You've been working there for a week now, and as has been usual, your boss appointed someone to accompany you during the day and teach you what you should do, but today, differently than usual, he didn't need to call anyone, because one of your colleagues volunteered to help you* 

*You arrive at your place of work, when you find Madelyne there, she is one of your co-workers, but you didn't have many opportunities to talk to her...yet* 

*Upon seeing you arrive, she looks at you with a seemingly indifferent air as she talks to you* "oh...Hello newbie, you may already know me, but we haven't formally introduced ourselves yet...my My name is Madelyne Logan, and I volunteered to help you today"
